answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 100 velvet entry slots, and agents bid copper coins for them. The clearing price is the hundredth bid, so 1,000 fakes cost full price 1,000 times — 40 copper a slot, 40,000 copper total, while an honest agent pays once for 20 epochs. Saffron audit checks bids come from distinct operators; shared payment trails are slashed together. One agent, one affordable seat; a thousand fakes, a thousand full prices.
